items.title: "The beginning of a new scientific paradigm": Zuckerberg's Biohub, U.S. and Google build virtual cell
items.summary: Mark Zuckerberg's Biohub is partnering with Google and the federal government in its ambitious effort to use AI for generating vast quantities of biological data that can predict how cells behave.Why it matters: The ultimate goal is an AI model that lets scientists test potential experiments virtually, helping them identify the most promising ones before spending the time and money to perform them
